    AI Overview
    The Masters Tournament is played annually at Augusta National Golf Club in Augusta, Georgia, USA. As one of the four major championships in men's professional golf, it is the only major held at the same venue every year. The tournament typically takes place in the first full week of April. 
    Key Facts About the Venue: 
    • Location: Augusta, Georgia, U.S.
    • Course: Augusta National Golf Club
    • Established: 1934
    • Significance: Known for its pristine, landscaped course, difficult, undulating greens, and iconic holes (including "Amen Corner," which covers holes 11, 12, and 13).
    • Tournament Time: Always the second Sunday in April. 
    Unlike other major golf championships that rotate locations, Augusta National is the permanent home of the Masters.

    People also ask
    How much does it cost to go to the Masters?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    Attending the Masters in 2026 costs from $1,000–$1,500 for a budget trip (lottery tickets +1-2 nights lodging) to over $20,000 for high-end, third-party resale packages. Official lottery tickets are cheap ($125–$160/day), but on the secondary market, daily tickets can range from $1,000 to over $20,000, while lodging near Augusta can be over $450+ per night. 
    Ticket Prices (Official 2026 Lottery - Face Value) 
    • Practice Rounds (Mon-Wed): $125–$150.
    • Tournament Days (Thu-Sun): $160.
    • Weekly Series Badge: $525. 
    Estimated Trip Costs (2026 Season)
     
    • Budget (Lottery Winner): ~$1,000–$1,500 per person, including tickets, hotel 1–2 hours away, and food.
    • Luxury (Resale Tickets): $6,000–$20,000+ for lodging, private home rentals, and tickets.
    • Food/Merch: Exceptionally affordable food ($1.50–$6), but high spending in the gift shop. 
    Key Tips 
    • Lottery: The only way to get cheap tickets is to win the official Masters Ticket Lottery which opens in June for the following year.
    • Resale Risk: Tickets purchased from third parties are unauthorized and may not be honored at the gate.
    • Travel: Flights into Augusta (AGS) are expensive; flying into Atlanta (ATL) and driving 2-3 hours saves significantly.
